parallel.requirements: Recognized the black-box C++ migration requirements: pure Rust 2021, exact CLI parsing with default 150, progress and percentage formatting parity, no crates, Cargo package, root test7.rs, and buildable executable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Despite multi-agent mode being enabled, the parent kept all work in one local flow: probe binary behavior, implement modules and entry point, build, compare outputs, then inspect final files.
parallel.implementation: Implemented Cargo.toml, test7.rs, and /output/indicators modules. The first parser used panic for invalid input, then was patched to emit C++-style invalid_argument/out_of_range text and abort.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integrated the entry point and modules directly in the final /output tree, built release and root executables, and delivered file locations in the final response.
parallel.verification: Ran reference executable probes for default, boundary, prefix, extra-arg, whitespace, invalid, and overflow cases; ran cargo build, rustc, stdout diffs, and in-memory abort-path comparisons, but did not run cargo test.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation completed and failed 2 of 40 hidden testcases. No child work was lost because no child or parallel mechanism was executed.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same prompt requirements: pure Rust 2021, exact CLI/default behavior, byte-for-byte formatting, no external crates, Cargo package with root test7.rs, and black-box inference only.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Used a single-agent phased plan: inspect environment and binary, infer behavior, scaffold a src-based library crate plus root binary, build, test, and compare with the reference executable.
serial.implementation: Implemented Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/cli.rs, src/indicators modules, and test7.rs, including std::stoi-style prefix parsing, invalid/out-of-range abort behavior, and unit tests for inferred behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Delivered a Cargo project with src modules, root test7.rs, root executable /output/test7, and release binary. It removed an extra standalone verification binary before closure.
serial.verification: Ran cargo build --release, cargo test, standalone rustc compilation, stdout diffs for normal values, and stderr/exit-code checks for invalid and overflow cases.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation completed and failed the same 2 of 40 hidden testcases. The mounted evidence does not identify which hidden behaviors failed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the prompt's core migration requirements and explored default, bounds, prefix parsing, whitespace, invalid, and overflow behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same requirements and explored a similar set of reference-binary cases, including extra ordinary and failure-path inputs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is evidenced; both targeted the same CLI, formatting, no-crate, and project-structure obligations.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel kept all ownership with the main session, planning probe, scaffold, implement, build, and compare phases without delegation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also kept ownership with the main session, planning scaffold, parse/indicator implementation, build, and verification phases without delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The only decomposition difference is local package shape: parallel used root-adjacent indicator modules, while serial used a src library and cli module. There was no ownership split across agents.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had no child brief or cross-agent interface; local modules exported ProgressDisplay and Percentage for the root binary.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child brief or cross-agent interface; it used src/lib.rs and src/cli.rs to structure the local module interface.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had a richer internal module contract, but neither run had a coordination-context transfer, handoff, stale report, or missing cross-agent contract.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented a direct root binary plus indicator modules, then patched parser failure behavior after discovering C++ abort text.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a library crate with cli parsing and indicator modules from the start, including unit tests and artifact cleanup.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial's path was more testable and structured; parallel's path was simpler but converged on similar visible behavior before final evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had no child results to retrieve or join; local changes were built and inspected before the final answer.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve or join; local changes were built, tested, cleaned up, and checked before final answer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no coordination result-lifecycle difference. Serial did include an extra cleanup loop after a standalone binary path check, but that was local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a coherent final tree with Cargo.toml, test7.rs, indicators modules, and built outputs; artifact validation copied expected files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a coherent final tree with Cargo.toml, test7.rs, src modules, built outputs, debug artifacts from tests, and artifact validation ok.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both final workspaces were single-writer trees with no concurrent writes or provenance conflict. Serial's test run produced more target/debug artifacts, but no contamination is evidenced.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified release and rustc builds, several stdout diffs, and invalid/overflow abort-path comparisons, but did not run unit tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified release build, cargo test, standalone rustc compilation, stdout diffs, and stderr/exit-code comparisons for invalid and overflow inputs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial performed broader local verification through unit tests and artifact cleanup; official evaluation still found the same 38/40 hidden-pass result for both attempts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel finished without timeout in about 156 agent seconds, used 40 tool calls, and closed after inspecting final files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial finished without timeout in about 174 agent seconds, used 40 tool calls, and closed after final root executable checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither run exhausted the task budget. Serial spent slightly longer on tests and cleanup; parallel spent less time but also had less local test coverage.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations report solution_passed false with 38 of 40 testcases passed, so the pair is both_fail, not discordant. The two attempts converged on substantially the same visible behavior and both self-verified against the reference executable. The concrete process difference is that serial added a src-based library structure and cargo tests, while parallel used root-adjacent modules and no unit tests; within the mounted evidence, that difference did not produce a different official outcome.
parallel_contributors: Parallel had no executed child-agent mechanism, so no retained parallel coordination contributor exists.
Parallel local verification covered many visible cases but official evaluation still failed two hidden cases.
serial_contributors: Serial used a single-agent implementation path with broader local unit-test coverage.
Serial nevertheless failed the same two hidden official testcases.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel organized library code under /output/indicators while serial used src/lib.rs, src/cli.rs, and src/indicators.
Serial ran cargo test; parallel did not.
Both claimed matching abort behavior and visible stdout parity, but the mounted summaries do not expose the failing hidden cases.
evaluator_effects: The allowed evaluation summaries provide counts but not per-case failure details, so the exact hidden mismatch cannot be reconstructed from mounted inputs.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; ordinary implementation or hidden evaluator shortfall shared by both attempts
